news_list.headline: Bill Gates Says Climate Change 'Will Not Lead to Humanity's Demise'
news_list.subhead: In a memo, the Microsoft co-founder warned against a “doomsday outlook” and appeared to have shifted some of his views about the risks of a warming planet.

news_list.headline: Sudan's Military Withdraws From Key City in Darfur After Monthlong Battle
news_list.subhead: Sudan's military chief confirmed that his forces had withdrawn from El Fasher, a decisive shift in control of the sprawling Darfur region.

news_list.headline: What Should I Wear to a Halloween Party if I Hate Dressing Up?
news_list.subhead: If forcing yourself into a costume is the scariest part of your holiday, our critic has some guidance for low-effort outfits that still get in the spirit.

news_list.headline: What to Know About Vaccinating Your Dog or Cat
news_list.subhead: Vaccine hesitancy is on the rise among pet owners. Here are answers to some common questions about animal vaccines.

news_list.headline: Live Updates: Jamaica Warns Hurricane Melissa Will Bring Catastrophic Winds and Rain
news_list.subhead: The Category 5 storm is the most powerful in the Atlantic Ocean this year. The authorities in Jamaica and Cuba have issued evacuation orders for tens of thousands of people.
